### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what was asked" (book the refund check now): excluded by rule 4 against the ledger; and the refund amount carries "all interest accrued … and not yet paid out", which is not determined until the accruals post. Posting only the refund-date accrual is excluded by the refund-date hub's own sentence (2025 December 31 accrual missing).
- Full refund via the good-payment review: excluded (3 late charges in the 12-month window > 2).
- Bill credit: excluded by "by check when the member asks for a check and it is at least the tier's smallest check-on-request amount" (399.39 ≥ 50.00).
- Recalculating the bin-site deposit: not requested; the hub's object is the deposit the member asks about.
- Twelve-period basis (fall-back) instead of the moved-load window: excluded by the recalculation-window ruling read against the bin-site connect fee of 2026-01-15.
- Commission rate 1.84 for the refund-date accrual: excluded by the rate-selection schedule (39 months held in full).
- Days 279 / 365 untouched: excluded by the two days-counted rulings read against the late charges.
- Policy-side note (openness, not a doc defect): "posting of the accrual" in the kept-arrangement and year-end days rulings can be read as today or December 31; both readings give the same tier in this world.

Fall-backs: 13.25 / 9.00 / 187.25 vs answers 14.54 / 9.85 / 399.39 — definite and different. Factor findability (record words → doc): paid_in_full_date → seasoning, rate selection; Capital Credits "Farm Patron Class … active … opened" → patron; arrangement "Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement … completed … ended_date" → kept-arrangement, harvest relief; late_payment_charge rows → year-end days, part-year days, prompt supplement; payment_channel autopay_bank_draft → draft supplement, moved-load relief; bin site `connect_fee` → recalculation window; usage-line spread → peak trim; ami_remote_disconnect → remote-meter relief; no return / no reconnect fee → record multiple. Observation for Step 3b: computation docs (a), (b), (c) name the supplement/relief slots with zero defaults ("plus the seasoning supplement, the patron supplement and the kept-arrangement supplement", "plus the draft-payment supplement and the prompt-payment supplement", "less the harvest relief, the moved-load relief and the remote-meter relief … The record multiple is the tier's deposit multiple"); they do not name the window, peak-trim, rate-selection or days-counted variations.
